environment: Windows 11; Java 21.0.10; Gradle 8.12; Node 24.14.0; npm 11.9.0; Docker Server 28.5.2

checks.name: attendance Mongo transaction, race and nanos replay regression
checks.evidence: 17 tests, 0 failed/errors/skipped; real Mongo replica set. Includes 299.999/300s, window boundaries, same/different-key concurrency, geo/approve/reject/manual races, rollback, immutable replay and JVM nanoseconds to Mongo milliseconds parity.

checks.name: late-check-in event contract
checks.evidence: 4 tests, 0 failed/errors/skipped; requested/decided payloads validate, including CANCELLED/GEO_CONFIRMED and optional null subject_name omission.

checks.name: signed JWT HTTP to gRPC boundary
checks.evidence: 12 tests pass through a real HTTP server and real network gRPC server using production filters/interceptors. Invalid signature, expiry, issuer, audience, missing token, spoofed X-User headers, wrong role and group are rejected.

checks.name: canonical OpenAPI non-update drift gate
checks.evidence: 3 tests pass against the production controller; committed OpenAPI snapshot unchanged and both geo request variants conform.

checks.name: attendance Java-first OpenAPI and derived legacy types
checks.evidence: Update 45s and LF-stable non-update 45s pass. Semantic snapshot delta is limited to the four-status history description, CANCELLED query filter, and lowercase pending/approved/rejected/cancelled response status. All three generated attendance.types.ts changed by seven lines; second generation SHA-256 for all four generated service files in each app was unchanged.

checks.name: derived status alias compiler checks
checks.evidence: All three consumers compile against the generated lowercase four-status response enum; web-panel build completed in 13.857s with the same baseline warnings.

checks.name: gateway external JWT to Mobile BFF route
checks.evidence: 6 tests, 0 failed/errors/skipped; Mobile BFF route receives an issued internal token and spoofed identity headers are stripped.

checks.name: notification Java CANCELLED closure
checks.evidence: History 17/17 and push 24/24 pass; geo-cancelled requests create neither false rejected history nor push.

checks.name: notification bot full suite and coverage gate
checks.evidence: 230 tests pass; coverage 77.88% >= 50%. Cancelled actions close as geo-confirmed and callback UI waits for the authoritative decision.

checks.name: legacy consumer closure
checks.evidence: Mini-app 2/2; PWA 4/4; Angular production build 26.769s. CANCELLED is terminal/safe in all located consumers. Build warnings were pre-existing unused/CommonJS diagnostics and did not trigger unrelated edits.

checks.name: runtime artifact build
checks.evidence: All six Spring Boot executable jars built for the isolated runtime.

checks.name: runtime harness validation
checks.evidence: Syntax and required six boot jars validated before execution.

checks.name: full task-isolated runtime
checks.evidence: Five isolated infrastructure containers and six real services were UP. Gateway login and signed session/today/schedule reads passed; ETag/304 and foreign-semester 403 passed. Rabbit outage preserved an atomic PENDING receipt/request/pair/outbox; retry was byte-identical. Broker recovery delivered exactly one late_checkin.requested and one attendance.marked to a task-only sink with matching trace IDs. Coordinate check-in persisted PRESENT/STUDENT_GEO/null actor. Four invalid JWT variants returned 401 without mutation. All owned resources were cleaned.

diagnostics.result: attendance OpenAPI non-update drift failed 1/1 in 51s
diagnostics.cause: The Java enum and runtime supported CANCELLED while the committed attendance snapshot and generated consumers still exposed three states.
diagnostics.action: Bounded Java-first correction annotated the actual lowercase response values and four-state filter, updated the source description, regenerated all derivatives, and passed LF-stable non-update plus SHA-256 no-drift checks.

diagnostics.cause: A concurrent non-owner Gradle attempt collided with the root-owned run and could not delete output.bin.
diagnostics.action: No product code changed; all subsequent Gradle/runtime execution remained single-owner.

diagnostics.cause: Task seed schema, boolean text, then PowerShell byte[] response decoding in the new evidence harness.
diagnostics.action: Harness/seed corrections only; exact owned cleanup verified after each run.

diagnostics.cause: A reproduced product defect: the first ACK retained nanoseconds while Mongo replay retained milliseconds.
diagnostics.action: Window validation keeps full precision; persisted mutation/receipt/ACK time truncates to milliseconds. New Mongo regression and final runtime pass.

diagnostics.cause: Evidence projection omitted an absent Mongo null field.
diagnostics.action: Harness emits explicit null while attendance count/status/source prevents a missing document from passing.
